from: Rack up to 3 inches, though many parties get by without the #3 cam
Small nuts, with extras if you have them, for the delicate pitch 3 crux (5.10a)
All three pitch belays are bolted anchors

Descent: rappel about 25 m from the p3 anchor to a 3-bolt station, then either a 55 m double-rope rappel to the ground or a couple of shorter single-rope raps trending climber's left via the sport-wall anchors
A single 70 m rope also works for rappelling, or you can walk off
Most parties link into Lovin' Arms (5.11b) from the pitch 3 anchor rather than rapping — that adds three more pitches to the top of the Upper Wall
